articles.title: Nvidia considers $10B investment in potential record Anthropic IPO: Reuters
articles.snippet: Anthropic is said to be seeking to raise as much as $100 billion in the offering, which could value the AI company at about $2 trillion.

articles.title: Bitcoin Suisse to shift up to half of Swiss jobs abroad
articles.snippet: The Swiss crypto financial services firm plans to move back-office functions to lower-cost international hubs as it expands its global wealth and asset management business, according to Finews.

articles.title: Hyperliquid’s biggest risk is regulation, says Ran Neuner
articles.snippet: The Crypto Banter founder said Hyperliquid’s network effects give it a strong competitive moat, but regulatory uncertainty remains its biggest threat.

articles.title: Liquid Network resumes block production after $320M exploit
articles.snippet: Liquid restarted block production after deploying emergency software updates, though transactions and peg operations remain suspended as recovery efforts continue.

articles.title: Bitcoin Golden Cross Flickers Off as Rate-Hike Bets Firm Up
articles.snippet: A rapidly changing interest rates market has changed the near-term outlook on the Bitcoin chart. Here’s why.
